_meta.revised: 2026-10-14 - double-brace placeholders like every other template; the audio is wired into CreateVideo so the mp4 carries the voice; model, size, length, seed, steps and cfg are parameters
_meta.purpose: Wan 2.2 S2V - audio-driven, lip-synced video from one still + a wav.
_meta.verified: Every node signature read from /object_info on the live instance (2026-10-14): WanSoundImageToVideo takes positive/negative/vae/width/height/length/batch_size required, audio_encoder_output and ref_image OPTIONAL, returns (positive, negative, latent). CreateVideo takes an optional AUDIO input.
_meta.recipe: steps 20 / cfg 6.0 / fps 16 / 77 frames per chunk (~4.8 s) is the official recipe. The I2V lightx2v 4-step LoRAs are NOT wired in: Comfy's own docs say the Lightning path costs motion and quality on S2V.
_meta.licences: Wan 2.2 Apache-2.0, wav2vec2 Apache-2.0, umt5 Apache-2.0 - whole chain is shippable.
_meta.longer: WanSoundImageToVideoExtend adds another chunk from the previous latent; it is the purpose-built continuation and must be used instead of reseeding, which gives a motion burst at every seam. Not in this template yet.
